case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal and are willing to extend the contract term to 24 months to ensure long-term planning stability for both our houses.

However, an effective date of April 2027 delays the necessary adjustments too much; we therefore propose 1 January 2027. Under these conditions, and maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €51.80 per unit. For our offer, we state a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.40 per unit, with a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised proposal and appreciate the step you have taken towards our position. 

For generations, our family foundry has valued the deep ties and mutual trust we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. To honor our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to reduce our price to a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

We trust this concession reflects our dedication to our shared history and look forward to reaching an agreement. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and are pleased to see we are getting closer to an agreement. 

For generations, our family foundry has stood for craftsmanship and reliability, and we deeply value the long partnership we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. To bridge the remaining gap, we can offer a further reduced price of €50.70 per unit for the 24-month contract starting April 2027 with 30-day payment terms. We believe this is a fair compromise that honors our long-standing relationship.

Specifically, our Angebot stands at a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
